intro: Six product families, extruded and finished in Vietnam.

categories.name: Profile
categories.tagline: System profiles for windows, doors and partitions
categories.blurb: Thermal-break and plain extrusions in 6063-T5, drawn on 1,800-tonne and 2,500-tonne presses. Every system ships with its own gaskets, drainage and hardware set, so a fabricator receives a complete opening rather than a bundle of bars.

items.name: Sliding 93
items.spec: Frame depth 93 mm · 2 or 3 track · sash up to 200 kg
items.text: A wide-track sliding system for balcony and terrace openings. The 93 mm frame carries double glazing to 24 mm and takes a tandem roller rated for a 200 kg sash.

items.name: Casement 55 TB
items.spec: Frame depth 55 mm · polyamide thermal break 24 mm · Uf 2.1 W/m²K
items.text: The volume seller. A 24 mm polyamide strip separates inner and outer shells, which is what brings Uf down to 2.1 and keeps condensation off the inner face in air-conditioned rooms.

items.name: Mullion 50
items.spec: Face width 50 mm · depth 65–250 mm · infill to 32 mm
items.text: Stick-system mullion and transom for shopfronts and low-rise glazing. Depth is chosen per span, so one face width covers a single storey or a four-metre atrium bay.

items.name: Office Partition 40
items.spec: Face width 40 mm · single or double glazed · flush both sides
items.text: A slim demountable partition for fit-outs. Both faces sit flush with the glass, so the same profile reads identically from either side of the wall.

items.name: Industrial Extrusion
items.spec: 6061-T6 and 6082-T6 · to 12 m · mill, anodised or powder
items.text: Structural sections drawn to customer dies: solar mounting rails, conveyor frames, heat sinks and machine beds. Dies are cut in-house, first samples in 18 days.

categories.name: Facade
categories.tagline: Unitised and stick systems, panels and louvres
categories.blurb: Facade work is where tolerance stops being a number on a drawing. Units are assembled and water-tested in the factory, then shipped glazed, so the site crew hangs a finished bay instead of building one at height.

items.name: Unitised UC160
items.spec: Depth 160 mm · unit to 1.5 × 4.2 m · tested to AAMA 501
items.text: Factory-glazed unit with a split mullion and dual air seals. Each production run is water-tested at 720 Pa before it leaves the plant.

items.name: Composite Panel
items.spec: 4 mm · A2 or FR core · PVDF 3-coat
items.text: Aluminium composite in 1,220 and 1,500 mm widths. The A2 core is specified where the local code sets a limit on facade combustibility.

items.name: Solid Panel
items.spec: 2.5–4 mm sheet · folded and stiffened · any RAL
items.text: Single-skin folded panel with welded return legs and a bonded stiffener. Used where a composite core is not permitted, or where a deeper reveal is wanted.

items.name: Sun Louvre
items.spec: Blade 200–400 mm · fixed or adjustable · span to 4 m
items.text: Aerofoil blades on a concealed carrier. Blade pitch is set from the shading study rather than from a catalogue default.

items.name: Cassette Cladding
items.spec: Hook-on cassette · open or closed joint · rear-ventilated
items.text: Hook-on cassettes on a rail carrier, removable one at a time from the face. Sizes follow the setting-out grid, not the sheet size.

categories.name: Furniture
categories.tagline: Profiles for cabinetry, wardrobes and shopfitting
categories.blurb: Furniture profiles are judged by their edges and their finish, because they are seen and touched at arm's length. These run on a separate anodising line to keep handling marks off the visible faces.

items.name: G-Profile Handle
items.spec: Continuous handle · lengths to 5.8 m · anodised or brushed
items.text: A continuous recessed pull that replaces hardware on a handleless kitchen. Cut to the run so the shadow line is unbroken across a bank of doors.

items.name: Slim Door Frame
items.spec: Face 20 mm · glass 4–8 mm · mitre or butt corner
items.text: A 20 mm frame for glazed cabinet fronts. The gasket takes 4 to 8 mm, which covers clear, reeded and lacquered glass without a change of section.

items.name: Wardrobe Track
items.spec: Top-hung · door to 80 kg · soft close both ends
items.text: Top-hung sliding gear for wardrobe doors. The carriage is serviceable from the front, which matters in a fitted run with no side access.

items.name: LED Channel
items.spec: Recessed, surface or corner · opal or frosted diffuser
items.text: Extruded channel with a snap-in diffuser and end caps. Fin depth is set so the strip sits at the focal distance of the diffuser and no dots show.

items.name: Plinth & Skirting
items.spec: Height 100–150 mm · clip-on seal · adjustable foot
items.text: Cabinet plinth with a clip-on seal at the floor. Adjustable feet take up the 12 mm of level a screed usually leaves behind.

categories.name: Door's Accessory
categories.tagline: Shutter curtain, hardware and gaskets that ship with the system
categories.blurb: Hardware is sold with the profile it was tested against. A system that passes a 25,000-cycle test only holds that number with the hinge and gasket it was tested on, so the two travel together. The same rule puts the roller shutter range here: a shutter is quoted as a set, because the operator is sized against the weight of the curtain it lifts rather than against the size of the opening.

items.name: 3D Adjustable Hinge
items.spec: Leaf to 130 kg · ±3 mm on three axes · 25,000 cycles
items.text: Adjustable after installation on all three axes, which is what lets a door be squared against an opening that moved after the frame went in.

items.name: Multipoint Lock
items.spec: 3, 5 or 7 point · 35 mm backset · stainless keeps
items.text: Hooks and rollers on a single throw. Keeps are stainless because they are the part that stays wet on an exposed entrance.

items.name: Lever & Pull Set
items.spec: Anodised, powder or PVD · pull to 1,800 mm
items.text: Matched lever and pull in the same finish batch as the profile, so a door and its handle leave the plant the same colour.

items.name: EPDM Gasket Set
items.spec: Co-extruded · −40 to 120 °C · vulcanised corners
items.text: Corners are vulcanised rather than cut and butted, which is where a gasket usually starts leaking after the first thermal cycle.

items.name: Concealed Closer
items.spec: EN 2–4 · in-leaf · hold-open option
items.text: Closer housed inside the leaf, invisible when the door is shut. Force is adjustable across EN 2 to 4 without removing the door.

items.name: Automatic Latch, 3rd Generation
items.spec: Throws on close · anti-lift · no supply of its own · mechanical key release
items.text: The bolt throws as the curtain lands and withdraws as it lifts, drawing no power, so it still holds through a cut or a flood. A mechanical key releases it when the door has to be raised by hand.

items.name: AC Shutter Operator
items.spec: Single-skin curtains · capacity matched to curtain weight
items.text: The AC operator for single-skin curtains. Capacity is chosen against the weighed curtain rather than the opening area, because weight is what actually loads the motor.

items.name: BossRM 1000 Shutter Operator
items.spec: 1,000 kg · openings 35–40 m² · motor, two controls, two flanges, receiver
items.text: For wide-span curtains of 35 to 40 m². Supplied with both flanges, since an operator this size is usually set out on the barrel before the curtain is hung.

items.name: BossRM 2000 Shutter Operator, three phase
items.spec: 2,000 kg · three phase · openings above 40 m² · motor, two controls, two flanges, receiver
items.text: Reference BRM.2000. The three-phase operator for industrial curtains past 40 m², which is where a single-phase motor starts running hot on a duty cycle.

items.name: BossRM 300 Shutter Operator
items.spec: 300 kg · openings 15–20 m² · motor, two controls, receiver
items.text: The entry operator in the BossRM range, for a domestic opening of 15 to 20 m². Supplied with the control box and receiver it was tuned against.

items.name: BossRM 500 Shutter Operator
items.spec: 500 kg · openings 20–25 m² · motor, two controls, receiver
items.text: For openings of 20 to 25 m². The motor body and the control box are one item: the limits are set at the box, not on the motor, so a service call does not need the curtain dropped.

items.name: BossRM 700 Shutter Operator
items.spec: 700 kg · openings 25–35 m² · motor, two controls, receiver
items.text: The step between the domestic and the wide-span operators, covering 25 to 35 m². Single phase, so it fits a unit without a three-phase supply at the door.

items.name: HV Wide-Span DC Operator
items.spec: Openings above 25 m² · hand lift on power failure · motor, two controls, receiver
items.text: The DC operator for hand-lift single-skin curtains past 25 m², where the standard DC unit runs out of travel rather than out of torque.

items.name: Kasankie DC 300 Shutter Operator
items.spec: 300 kg · motor, two controls, two flanges, receiver
items.text: The 300 kg unit in the Kasankie DC range. Several power steps share one mounting, so a door that gains weight in refurbishment takes the next motor up without new flanges.

items.name: Kasankie DC 400 Shutter Operator
items.spec: 400 kg · openings 15–20 m² · motor, two controls, two flanges, receiver
items.text: The 400 kg unit, covering openings of 15 to 20 m² on the same mounting as the 300.

items.name: Kasankie Eco 300 Shutter Operator
items.spec: 300 kg · brake housing turns through 360° · left or right hand
items.text: The brake housing rotates through a full turn, so one part number handles a left-hand and a right-hand installation instead of two.

items.name: Kasankie Eco 500 Shutter Operator
items.spec: 500 kg · brake housing turns through 360° · left or right hand
items.text: The 500 kg unit in the Eco range, on the same rotating brake housing as the 300.

items.name: Robust 1000 Shutter Operator
items.spec: 1,000 kg · openings 35–40 m² · motor, two controls, two flanges, receiver
items.text: The largest single-phase unit in the Robust range, for curtains of 35 to 40 m².

items.name: Robust 400 Shutter Operator
items.spec: 400 kg · openings to 15 m² · motor, two controls, two flanges, receiver
items.text: The 400 kg operator for openings up to 15 m² — a house, a garage or a showroom front. Paired to the handset at the control box.

items.name: Robust 600 Shutter Operator
items.spec: 600 kg · openings 20–25 m² · motor, two controls, two flanges, receiver
items.text: For openings of 20 to 25 m², one step above the 400 on the same mounting.

items.name: Robust DC Single Operator
items.spec: Single-skin curtains · hand lift on power failure · motor, two controls, receiver
items.text: The single version of the same DC operator, for a smaller single-skin curtain. Same hand lift on a power failure.

items.name: Robust DC Twin Operator
items.spec: Openings 12–30 m² · hand lift on power failure · motor, two controls, receiver
items.text: A twin DC operator for single-skin curtains between 12 and 30 m². On a power failure the curtain lifts by hand without a release to find first.

items.name: Robust ECO 400 Shutter Operator
items.spec: 400 kg · motor, two controls, two flanges, receiver
items.text: The economy build of the 400 kg operator. Same capacity and the same remote pairing; fewer options at the control box.

items.name: Robust ECO 600 Shutter Operator
items.spec: 600 kg · openings 20–25 m² · motor, two controls, two flanges, receiver
items.text: The economy build at 600 kg, covering openings of 20 to 25 m².

items.name: YH 1300 Shutter Operator, three phase
items.spec: 1,300 kg · three phase · openings 40–45 m² · motor, two controls, two flanges, receiver
items.text: The three-phase unit for curtains of 40 to 45 m², supplied with the control box and receiver as one set.

items.name: YH 300 Shutter Operator
items.spec: 300 kg · openings to 15 m² · motor, two controls, two flanges, receiver
items.text: The 300 kg operator for openings up to 15 m², on the same four-part pack as the rest of the range.

items.name: YH 400 Shutter Operator
items.spec: 400 kg · openings 15–20 m² · motor, two controls, two flanges, receiver
items.text: For openings of 15 to 20 m² — house, garage or showroom fronts.

items.name: YH 500 Shutter Operator
items.spec: 500 kg · openings 20–25 m² · motor, two controls, two flanges, receiver
items.text: For openings of 20 to 25 m², one step above the 400 on the same mounting.

items.name: Rolling-Code Handset
items.spec: Rolling code (ARC) · paired to the control box · replaceable on site
items.text: Every cycle retires the code it just used and issues the next one, so a captured transmission will not open the door twice. Handsets pair to the control box, not to the motor, so a lost handset is cleared without opening the headbox.

items.name: BS-2550 Battery Back-up
items.spec: 600 VA · 150–250 V in, 220 V out · 8 × 3.2 V / 6 Ah LiFePO₄ · motors to 400 kg
items.text: Lithium iron phosphate rather than lead-acid: 2,000 charge cycles against 500, and above 80% of rated capacity at the end of them. Standby is 32 to 48 hours. Case 281 × 195 × 58 mm, with overload and short-circuit protection.

items.name: BS-2580 Battery Back-up
items.spec: 1,200 VA · 150–250 V in, 220 V out · 8 × 3.2 V / 15 Ah LiFePO₄ · motors to 800 kg
items.text: The larger of the two back-up units, for motors up to 800 kg and a standby of 48 to 72 hours. Case 295 × 252 × 63 mm, with overload and short-circuit protection.

items.name: BO57.0325 Vented Slat
items.text: The heavy end of the standard vented range. Perforations run the length of the slat, so a closed shutter still moves air across a shopfront that trades with the front down.

items.name: BO5816.0325 Vented Slat
items.spec: 6063-T5 · vented · two-way felt seal
items.text: Hooks and load points were redrawn on this section and the guide carries a two-way felt seal. Both changes are about noise on the way down rather than about strength.

items.name: BO601.0325 Vented Slat
items.text: The 2025 revision of the standard vented slat. It holds the same opening range as the section it replaces on a thinner gauge and a tighter thickness tolerance.

items.name: BO602.0325 Vented Slat
items.text: The lightest slat in the range, for openings up to 4.5 m square. Vented on the standard pitch and held in light grey as the stock finish.

items.name: BO68S.0325 Clear-View Slat
items.spec: Clear-view slat · gauge and finish to order
items.text: An open slat for a shopfront that has to stay visible when it is shut. Gauge and finish are set against the opening rather than held as a stock combination.

items.name: BO90A.0325 Wide-Span Slat
items.spec: Wide-span section · anti-lift latch · obstacle reverse
items.text: The wide-span section for openings past the domestic range. The latch engages as the curtain lands, so a closed door cannot be levered up at the bottom rail.

items.name: CD.100 Wide-Span Slat
items.text: The largest section in the range, closing an opening up to 10.5 m wide. Slat ends are capped in three layers, which is the joint that takes the wear on a door this size.

items.name: CD.140NT Wide-Span Slat
items.spec: 6063-T5/T6 · curved face · removable translucent vent inserts
items.text: A wide-span slat with a curved face and oversized vents. The inserts are translucent and come out, so the same door runs closed and lit, or closed and open to the air.

items.name: CD.80 Wide-Span Slat
items.text: The middle wide-span slat, thickened in 2020 over the section it replaced. Powder coated on the automatic line; light grey is the stock colour.

categories.name: Car's Accessory
categories.tagline: Extrusions and pressings for the automotive tier
categories.blurb: Automotive parts are made to a drawing and a PPAP file, not to a catalogue. This line runs to IATF 16949 with full traceability from billet lot to packed carton.

items.name: Roof Rail
items.spec: 6063-T6 · stretch-formed · anodised or PVD
items.text: Stretch-formed rail with a machined foot. Curvature is held to the body datum, not to the rail's own centreline.

items.name: EV Battery Tray Section
items.spec: 6082-T6 · friction-stir welded · leak tested
items.text: Multi-void extrusion for battery enclosures, friction-stir welded and helium leak tested. Wall thickness is set by the crash case, not by the press.

items.name: Body Side Trim
items.spec: Bright anodised · roll-formed clip · UV stable
items.text: Bright-anodised trim with an integral clip channel. The anodic layer is specified at 15 microns for road salt exposure.

items.name: Bumper Beam
items.spec: 7003-T6 · crush-can interface · CAE validated
items.text: Closed-section beam in 7003, drawn and then bent to the sweep. Section is signed off against the customer's own crash model.

items.name: Power Module Heat Sink
items.spec: Fin pitch to 2 mm · aspect ratio 18:1 · skived option
items.text: High-aspect fins for inverter and charger modules. Where the pitch goes below 2 mm the part is skived rather than extruded.

categories.name: Honeycomb
categories.tagline: Aluminium honeycomb core and bonded panels
categories.blurb: Honeycomb buys stiffness per kilogram. A 25 mm bonded panel is roughly the bending stiffness of 12 mm solid aluminium at about a fifth of the weight, which is why it ends up in lifts, ceilings and vehicle interiors.

items.name: Bare Core
items.spec: Cell 6–19 mm · foil 40–80 µm · blocks or slices
items.text: Expanded 3003 core supplied as block or cut slice. Cell size and foil gauge are chosen from the shear load, not from what is in stock.

items.name: Bonded Panel
items.text: Core bonded between aluminium skins on a heated press. Flatness holds within 0.5 mm per metre after cure.

items.name: Lift Car Panel
items.spec: Class A2 · stainless or anodised face · edge-sealed
items.text: Panels for lift cars and doors, where the weight saved comes straight off the counterweight and the motor duty.

items.name: Ceiling Raft
items.spec: Perforated face · acoustic fleece · NRC to 0.85
items.text: Perforated face with a fleece backing behind the core. Perforation pattern is set from the absorption target for the room.

items.name: Vehicle Floor Panel
items.spec: Non-slip face · 25–40 mm · point load 300 kg
items.text: Bus and rail floor panel with a bonded non-slip face. Rated for a 300 kg point load on a 100 mm footprint.
